title: Review schedule changes, cancellations and Updates
summary: Review changes without assuming an earlier plan has moved or been rebooked.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Review a changed or cancelled planned session
paragraphs: Sign in to the account that made the plan. Use Care Calendar’s Updates when a session you added to My Plans has changed; your earlier choice is not moved automatically.
steps: Open Care Calendar and select Updates.
Find the Programme/service with a change. Compare the dates and times under Your affected plans with Current sessions.
If you no longer want an earlier plan, select Remove old plan on that exact entry. This removes your personal calendar plan immediately.
If a suitable current active session is offered, select Add to My Plans on that session. If it already says In My Plans, it is already in your list.
Open My Plans to check the session you chose. Check current details and any registration separately with the provider.
Return to Updates and select Acknowledge update when you have finished reviewing the change. This clears the notice; it does not choose a replacement for you.
notes: If there are no active replacement sessions, do not assume your old date is still available. Open the activity for the latest details or contact the provider.
Removing an old plan, adding a replacement and acknowledging a notice are separate actions. None changes the provider’s schedule or cancels or creates a provider booking.
If a calendar action reports an error, check My Plans and Updates again before deciding whether to retry. Hidden or unpublished sessions can leave earlier personal plans for you to review.

facts.title: Review a changed planned session
facts.message: If an Offering schedule changes after you add a session to My Plans, your old choice is not moved automatically. Open Care Calendar > Updates to compare affected plans with current sessions. Remove an old plan and choose Add to My Plans on a current active session if needed. Acknowledging the update removes the notice; it does not add a new plan or book you with the provider. Recheck details with the provider before relying on a date.

sections.title: Hiding a Programme and existing personal plans

facts.title: Hiding a Programme and existing personal plans
keywords: turn off calendar sessions people planned
facts.message: Hiding a Programme/service does not automatically delete an existing personal plan. While hidden, its current sessions are not offered as Care Calendar occurrences; turning off or unpublishing its sessions likewise does not delete a personal plan. A person can still see their own earlier plan in My Plans and may need to review a changed schedule in Updates. A plan is not a provider booking. The Guide cannot identify who planned the Programme or edit another person’s plans; check current details with the provider before relying on an old date.
